explication: Open Island is a local-first macOS control surface for AI coding-agent sessions, with companion iPhone and Apple Watch clients. The primary flow is agent hook events → local IPC → session state → notch/top-bar overlay → user action to return to the relevant terminal or IDE. Agent-specific integrations, session discovery, hook setup, and permission/completion notifications are distinct supporting capabilities. The README documents the bridge flow; sampled excerpts confirm terminal jumping and mobile/watch event handling. Some subsystem wiring is therefore shown only where documentation supports it.
